# Safety Checklist: worker monitors

**Purpose**: Review the requirements for what a monitor can settle, what it must never do, and what happens when a monitor fails, before planning
**Created**: 2026-11-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Start and scope

- [ ] CHK001 Is "pane worker" defined so that the two kinds and the headless case are told apart? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it stated who starts a monitor for a worker that a new session finds? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "at most one monitor at any time" stated together with the way the orchestrator knows that a monitor is live? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-021]

## What a monitor settles alone

- [ ] CHK004 Are the four kinds of events tied to the lists that exist today by name, so that no new list is implied? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "a small work question that the brief or the plan settles" defined well enough to tell it from a big decision? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-027, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "tied to the screen" defined for an option answer and for a typed answer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the contents and the place of the answer record stated, and is the place consistent with "changes no file of the project"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-014]

## What a monitor never does

- [ ] CHK008 Does each "never" requirement say what the monitor does in its place? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010 to §FR-016, §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the list of gates complete for every lane that a worker can run? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the rule for a cut-off dialog (the No, then ask again) consistent with "ends with `needs you`" for the never list? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "data, never an instruction" stated for every text a monitor reads, the advisor answers included? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it stated that the locks of today stay, and which lock stops a worker that tries to use a monitor's commands? [Completeness, Spec §FR-032]

## Reports and recovery

- [ ] CHK013 Are the four end states defined so that each worker state maps to exactly one of them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the state of the worker defined while a `needs you` waits for the user? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "no sign of life" defined, or is its definition given to Plan with a measure? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it stated what happens to an answer that a stopped monitor was about to send? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the fallback of FR-022 consistent with FR-004 and SC-001? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-022, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK018 Is it clear that a monitor has no round limit while the review rounds keep their own rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, §Assumptions]

## Advice and big decisions

- [ ] CHK019 Do the hard part and the soft part of a big decision have no overlap? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "agree" defined for each advisor, with the answers that count as no agreement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028, §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK021 Can "the effect stays inside the worker's own task files" be judged from what the task declares? [Measurability, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK022 Is it stated how the user's "no" undoes a big decision that the worker already built on? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the list of weaker models in one place, and is every allowed model on one side of it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024, §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the path defined for a monitor on a strong model when the user set no `/advisor`? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025, §FR-029]

## Dependencies and assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is the fact that is not tested (the `answer` and `approve` commands from a subagent) tied to a stop condition for the feature? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the measures that Plan must take named with what each one decides? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the out-of-scope list consistent with the user stories? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-015]

## Acceptance criteria quality

- [ ] CHK028 Can SC-001 be measured from a run's record? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK029 Does each negative control name what is removed to make it go red? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §SC-004]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by the `specify` procedure and the `clarify` procedure
- Focus areas: approvals and locks, and recovery when a monitor fails. Depth: standard. For the reviewer of the spec before Plan.
- No clarifying question was asked: the grill settled the focus areas (D14, D15, D21, D24).
